definitions.gloss: tablespoon; large spoon used as a cooking measure
definitions.explanation: A unit of measurement in cooking equivalent to 15 milliliters. Also refers to the physical measuring spoon itself.

examples.japanese: {醤油|しょうゆ}{大|おお}さじ{一杯|いっぱい}。
{砂糖|さとう}を{大|おお}さじ{二杯|にはい}{加|くわ}えてください。
examples.english: Please add two tablespoons of sugar.

examples.japanese: このレシピでは{大|おお}さじ{三杯|さんばい}の{味噌|みそ}を{使|つか}います。
examples.english: This recipe uses three tablespoons of miso.

notes:
A standard cooking measurement in Japan equal to 15 mL. The term is composed of {大|おお} (big) + さじ (spoon), contrasting with {小|こ}さじ (teaspoon, 5 mL). Japanese recipes almost always specify amounts using {大|おお}さじ and {小|こ}さじ rather than grams for liquid seasonings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}さじ{一杯|いっぱい}: one tablespoon
- {大|おお}さじ{半分|はんぶん}: half a tablespoon
- {大|おお}さじ{山盛|やまも}り: a heaping tablespoon
- {計量|けいりょう}スプーン: measuring spoon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小|こ}さじ: teaspoon — 5 mL, one-third of a tablespoon
- カップ: cup — 200 mL in Japanese cooking (not 240 mL as in the US)
